leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Construct a new Angular component using the CLI to serve as the orders list page
Apply Angular routing to define a route that maps a URL path to the orders component
Implement a TypeScript interface to define the structure of an order object with required properties
Utilize array iteration with *ngFor to display a list of order items in the template
Assign mock order data to a component property to simulate API data retrieval
Access component properties in the template using interpolation to display order details
Modify the component template to structure order information with appropriate HTML elements
Use Angular's built-in date pipe to format order dates for display
Apply CSS classes to style the orders list for visual presentation
Control template rendering with *ngIf to handle empty order lists gracefully
Define a click handler method to navigate to order details when an order is selected
Implement property binding to connect the click handler to order list items
